required_products: Frequency maps T/Q/U for predeclared channels
Half-ring maps or the finest available split products
Hit maps and noise covariance/inverse covariance
Masks: temperature, polarization, point-source and Galactic masks, with apodization recipe
QuickPol effective beam windows and pixel windows
Matched end-to-end simulations or an explicitly justified, separately labelled null route
notes: Use 030/353 foreground-sensitive channels and 070/100/143 CMB-dominant channels as complementary inputs only after foreground and bandpass model is specified.
The 100/143/217 GHz E-mode low-ell transfer response must be checked against the NPIPE calibration/processing transfer; never assume unity.
Do not combine component-separated methods as independent likelihood factors for one sky.
CMB-S4 portal reports full-sky, half-ring, low-resolution and QuickPol product families; use its per-dataset JSON manifest for filenames, byte sizes and checksums.
NPIPE/PR4 observed maps and FFP10/PR3 simulations are not one matched end-to-end ensemble.
local_agent_tasks: Inspect current raw candidate directories before downloading.
Download manifest first; select exact required files and preserve official names.
Save source URL, release, portal manifest, file bytes, SHA256, FITS headers, units, nside, ordering, coordinate frame, beam and calibration metadata.
Build a map/mask/beam/transfer identity tuple and ensure the observed map and every mock use the same processing.

notes: This is a PR3/FFP10 robustness lane, not a matched replacement for PR4/NPIPE.
Only use if the observed data are exactly the corresponding SMICA PR3 product, mask and pipeline.
Prior K1 guide identifies PLA simulation query as interactive; local agent must verify current access and not assume static URLs.

required: Stable row IDs, full 1701-row ordering and exact selected covariance mapping
Redshift frame, calibrator and host metadata, selection and peculiar-velocity correction history
pantheon_plus.prohibition: Do not use selected caches or treat magnitudes transformed into distances as independent homoscedastic Gaussian data without deriving the transformation law.

required: Redshift, flux/magnitude, colour, quality and morphology/size columns
quaia_dr1.prohibition: No fixed rescaling between magnitude cuts; recompute response from the selected parent release.

required: Original source catalogue and component/group handling
Declination/coverage map, Galactic mask and completeness
Random catalogues or empirically calibrated selection response

racs_low_dr1.role: Independent radio-frequency replication, not naive pooling with NVSS.

required: source_id, ra, dec, ref_epoch, pmra, pmdec
CRF3 tie/auxiliary tables, frame spin and scan-law/systematic models
gaia_dr3_crf3.prohibition: Do not identify Gaia B1 spin with cosmic vorticity without an external inertial-frame tie; use source-level likelihood, not only precomputed VSH coefficients.

required: Full distance/velocity error and covariance provenance
Selection, flow model and redshift frame
cosmicflows4.prohibition: Do not use reconstructed velocities as independent observations or revive quarantined headlines before the original distance likelihood is reproduced.

required: Named release, full covariance, calibration and selection
des_sn5yr.role: Independent replication or separate stratum, not naive concatenation.

required: Raw angular clustering and randoms only if directional claim is attempted
desi_dr2.role: Compressed isotropic BAO provides background control, not a preferred-axis measurement.

sdss_spectroscopic.role: Redshift/selection response for local-versus-global dipole discrimination.
